upstream.name: WETH / ETH
upstream.note: Direct ETH market and network exposure. WETH does not add a liquid-staking protocol dependency, but remains correlated with both LST branches.

upstream.name: wstETH / Lido
upstream.source: CollateralRegistry and deployed immutable PriceFeed configuration, verified 2026-09-14
upstream.note: Imports Lido staking, withdrawal and exchange-rate risk in addition to ETH market risk.

upstream.name: rETH / Rocket Pool
upstream.source: CollateralRegistry and deployed immutable PriceFeed configuration, verified 2026-09-14
upstream.note: Imports Rocket Pool staking, withdrawal and exchange-rate risk in addition to ETH market risk. Its oracle uses the lower of market price and the protocol exchange rate.

upstream.name: Chainlink ETH/USD and LST rate feeds
upstream.source: deployed immutable PriceFeed configuration and internal BOLD assessment, verified 2026-09-14
upstream.note: Each branch has constructor-fixed oracle addresses and staleness thresholds with no setter. A revert, stale or zero feed permanently shuts down the affected branch rather than failing over; lastGoodPrice then supports urgent redemptions. rETH uses min(market, exchange-rate). Coinspect BOLD-05's possible cross-branch redemption halt was not established as remediated. Chainlink feed governance is outside the completed core authority walk.

downstream.name: sBOLD wrapper (material downstream)
downstream.metric: 13.1% of BOLD supply and 24.7% of Stability Pool deposits in the assessed backing payload
downstream.note: DOWNSTREAM, not collateral and not an upstream issuer dependency. sBOLD is tracked because material BOLD inventory sits behind a wrapper owner and pause surface. Those authority observations belong on axis 5 and are not priced again here; percentages are dated measurements, not timeless claims.

dependencies.note: The dependency chain is short and enumerable, but not absent. The collateral set is permanently closed to WETH, wstETH and rETH: the registry returns those three branches and then address(0), and no administrator can add another collateral. That fixed set does not remove Chainlink, Lido, Rocket Pool, ETH or the material downstream sBOLD wrapper. Live BOLD is identified by 0x6440f144b7e50D6a8439336510312d2F54beB01D, not by the case-colliding ticker.
